cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(odsl LANGUAGES CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)

# Bit-exact LUT and vectors are vendored from the inkengine anchor repo.
# They are generated by tools/gen_vectors.py there and are read-only here.
set(ODSL_INK_INCLUDE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}" CACHE PATH
    "Directory containing the generated ink_lut.hpp")

set(ODSL_VECTORS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/vectors.bin" CACHE FILEPATH
    "Bit-exact NVFP4 test vector file")

add_executable(odsl odsl.cpp)
target_include_directories(odsl PRIVATE "${ODSL_INK_INCLUDE}")
target_compile_definitions(odsl PRIVATE ODSL_VECTORS="${ODSL_VECTORS}")

configure_file("${ODSL_VECTORS}" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/vectors.bin" COPYONLY)
enable_testing()
add_test(NAME odsl_numeric_layout_model COMMAND odsl)
